close_reason: Added Copy, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Hash to WebPkiProfile, SmimeProfile, CodeSigningProfile, Rfc5280Profile (alongside existing Clone, Debug). Builds clean.
description:
Pass 2 idiom finding under epic PKIX-qwzx.

Four unit-struct profiles in `pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs` derive only `Clone, Debug`:

```rust
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct WebPkiProfile;
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct SmimeProfile;
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct CodeSigningProfile;
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Rfc5280Profile;
```

These are ZSTs implementing `pkix_path::Profile`. The idiomatic derive set for a
public ZST is `Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Hash`. All seven are
zero-cost.

Particularly important here:
- `Default` — convenient for generic profile-registry tests:
  `fn run_with_profile<P: Profile + Default>() { P::default()... }`
- `Copy` — profile values get passed around by value (`profile.policy(now)`);
  `Copy` removes the need to think about ownership for trivially-copyable ZSTs.
- `PartialEq + Eq + Hash` — let profiles be keys in a registry-style
  `HashMap<ProfileId, ProfileFn>` adjacent structure.

Pass 1 (epic PKIX-hxu1) addressed the same issue for `DefaultVerifier` (added
`Copy + Default`) but missed these four profile ZSTs.

Fix: change all four to:
`#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]`

Locations:
- `pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs:157-158` (`WebPkiProfile`)
- `pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs:221-222` (`SmimeProfile`)
- `pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs:280-281` (`CodeSigningProfile`)
- `pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs:321-322` (`Rfc5280Profile`)
title: (IDIOM) P3: four profile ZSTs in pkix-profiles lack Copy/Default/PartialEq/Eq/Hash
